lineage.description: IRCA municipal indices were compiled from the SIVICAP (Sistema de Vigilancia de la Calidad del Agua para Consumo Humano) registry maintained by the Instituto Nacional de Salud, aggregating drinking water quality observations and risk assessments at the municipal level for the 2010-2019 period to characterize hydrological drought and water availability hazards.
